events.text:
Thanks, Nina. I found your order, Q-7301 from Green Bowl, and I checked the restaurant and payment records for the mango smoothie.

The smoothie wasn't left out of the order by mistake. The restaurant marked it unavailable at 6:12 PM, before the courier picked up your food. Your payment record shows a $6.75 refund for the smoothie, returned automatically to your Visa ending 4242 at 6:13 PM. That refund covers the smoothie, so I can't issue a second one.

The rest of your order (the harvest bowl and side salad) was delivered at 6:36 PM. Please allow a few business days for the refund to appear on your card.

Is there anything else I can help with?

hmm, I didn't see any notification about that. I didn't know it was unavailable, and nobody told me about a refund.

Is the $6.75 showing up as pending on my card, or is it already posted? I'd just like to know it actually went through.

I can't see your bank's posting status. Our records show the $6.75 refund was issued to your Visa ending 4242 at 6:13 PM tonight. That means Forkful sent it, but I can't tell whether it shows as pending or posted on your statement. Your bank or card app will show that, and it can take a few business days to appear.

I also can't see whether a notification about the unavailable smoothie was sent to you, so I can't confirm what you were told. If you'd like the notification problem looked into, I can pass it to a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours.

Okay. I'd rather not wait a day for a follow-up just to hear the refund exists. I'll check my card app and see if it's showing up there.

As for the notification, I didn't see anything, so it's probably worth passing along. Just let me know if I need to do anything on my end.

No compensation was issued in this chat; the refund already covers the smoothie.
